# Ryan Stewart, DO — Urogynecologist in Green Bay, WI

> Dr. Ryan Stewart is a board-certified, fellowship-trained urogynecologist practicing urogynecology and reconstructive pelvic surgery in Green Bay, Wisconsin. This site offers patient education on female pelvic floor disorders — pelvic organ prolapse, urinary and fecal incontinence, and overactive bladder — along with the treatment options for each.

The information here is educational and is not a substitute for a consultation. Each condition and treatment page is written for patients by Dr. Stewart, and evidence-reviewed pages cite their sources in a References section. Dr. Stewart sees patients across Northeast Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula; no referral is required, and in-person and virtual visits are available.

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): Overview of Dr. Stewart's practice, expertise, and approach to care.
- [About]({{ site.url }}/about): Background, training, and philosophy of care.
- [Research]({{ site.url }}/research): Peer-reviewed publications in urogynecology and a book chapter on minimally invasive surgery.
- [Patient Testimonials]({{ site.url }}/testimonials): Reviews from patients across Google, Healthgrades, and US News.
- [Contact]({{ site.url }}/contact): Phone number and online booking through Aurora BayCare.
